description: Literature Review Paper Screener V1.1 is an AI-powered workflow that searches for relevant academic literature, builds structured Evidence Records for each paper, and independently screens and evaluates every paper before auditing and merging the results into an Excel Paper Sheet and prioritized Reading List. The local agent gathers the evidence; the cloud evaluates it.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent gather relevant evidence before concluding?
Did the final report trace conclusions back to observable evidence?
